findings.finding: Both the official decoder and parent formulation run in Torch CPU FP32 for one real layer; this checks semantics and is not a full-depth BF16 JAX-versus-Torch comparison.
Strassen and Cubic are compared against regular_xla on the same device and inputs. Relative hidden drift is reported; task gates use NLL/KL/top1. Parent reference_fidelity is separate.
Parent repaired a false divergence caused by attention_mask=None in official eager attention. Our v001/v002 oracle already provides an explicit causal mask.

Parent documented missing BOS degrading absolute task accuracy while same-model agreement cancelled the shared bug. Current repetitive Gemma4 qualification uses tokenizer template BOS id 2. Future natural loader uses add_special_tokens=False and needs correction before quality measurements.

Parent uses JAX dot_product_attention and FP32 intermediates for RoPE and GeGLU before final BF16 casts. It does not implement our explicit Torch eager BF16 score boundary or provide a Gemma4 cross-backend drift fix.
Gemma3 uses (1+w) RMSNorm. Gemma4 official source uses w directly, plus value normalization and layer scalar; direct Gemma3 copying would be wrong.
